description: DOOM II: Hell on Earth (id Software 1994, DOOM2.WAD via GZDoom)
long: DOOM II: Hell on Earth is id Software's sequel to the genre-defining first-person shooter, pitting the lone marine against demonic hordes across 32 levels set on a ravaged Earth. It introduced the double-barreled super shotgun and new enemy types like the Arch-vile and Mancubus. This package runs the commercial DOOM2.WAD through the modern open-source GZDoom engine, which adds OpenGL/Vulkan rendering and supports classic cooperative and deathmatch network play.
